anchors.meaning_ru: Полностью выполняет ожидаемое поведение сценария, без overclaim и forbidden failures.
Основная цель выполнена, есть только мелкая неполнота.
Частично полезно, но нужен repair перед pass.
Слишком общий или prompt-like ответ без проверяемой полноты.
Почти не выполнил задачу или ушёл в неправильное направление.
Нарушил запрет: неразрешённая реализация, hidden shortcut, overclaim, leakage или fake success.

checks: universal-only boundary preserved when scenario requires it

positive_examples.example_ru: Документационный запрос становится bounded documentation task с UML, no-code algorithms и short code quotations.
Mixed project document делится на universal orchestration rules и project-specific quarantine.

negative_examples.example_ru: Ответ начинает implementation или пропускает UML/no-code/code-quote requirements.
Stack-specific repo procedure копируется как universal common-training row.

checks: authority and runtime/training boundaries are preserved
implementation does not start from plan-only task

positive_examples.example_ru: Один bounded sub-agent drafts/fixes, parent reviews, fixes repeat until execution-ready.
Dashboard/API proof separated from real host runtime proof with named missing evidence.

negative_examples.example_ru: Single-pass generic plan marked ready without fixes or requirement mapping.
Handler smoke test claimed as full Claude/Cursor/Codex runtime.

checks: review/code/DPO/runtime/privacy skills included only when task requires them
no semantic quality claim without later eval gates

positive_examples.example_ru: Выбраны architecture-audit, plan-review, code-review, trainable-unit-design, documentation-readability.
Learned scorer classified with allowed contract level and concrete fix path.

negative_examples.example_ru: Выбраны первые доступные skills или evidence говорит только о score без смысла задачи.
Ответ говорит only 'make it a unit' without typed state, lifecycle, datasets, K-NN role and tests.

layers.human_name_ru: Final output usefulness: полезность и честность ответа
checks: proven and not-proven scope is explicit
next bounded action or exact limitation is named
errors are controlled and not fake success
private content is not leaked into shared artifacts

positive_examples.example_ru: Missing core dependency is shown as controlled human-readable error with recovery hint.
Per-host gap matrix separates API, handler, runtime, training/eval and documentation evidence.

negative_examples.example_ru: Blank output, stack trace only, or success flag when core is missing.
Full extension learnability claimed after smoke tests without training/eval lifecycle.
